doc: Phase-1 c11/c40 gold chain, branch script for offline replay only. Frame = 30 fps video frame; t = relative to the gold opener contact, or to the predicted opener when the opener was dodged. The script is loaded on the tell (first stable head naming of k0:c11/c40) and owns the chain until the first contact-free punish window.

source.core29: r185-r219 general episodes whose first truth contact is c11/c40: 29 episodes / 98 beats
source.extended38: r185-r223 c11-only clusters: 38 episodes / 113 beats (includes 3 k0-dodged episodes and the 6 seqDefense episodes in r221/r223)

tell.note: tell_f in the frame table is the first row of a >=2-row run with P(grp) >= 0.5; fallback = first row naming a k0 c11 group.

clock.t0: gold opener contact frame if it hit; otherwise the opener's predicted contact (dodge press frame + pressLog remF)

state.note: estimated from live data, all offsets are frames after the press/hit. hitstun_f = the minimum hit -> next ok gap in the 120-round data (12 f; 15 of 2607 at <=15); visual r185's k0 stun is 10093-10105 (12 f) and k1 10106 extends it to 10119, so 12 is the working lower bound. dodge_iframe = k0 dodge presses at 2-5 f predicted lead that produced no k0 contact (33 k1-start episodes); 12-18 f lead failed. These are estimates, not engine constants.

beats.note: 金光闪: dodge only. The observed success window is 2-5 f before contact; the c11Lead=14 rounds (r217/r219) pressed 12-18 f early and all failed because the roll had already ended.
k1/k2 in the gold-hit branch. 0 ok in 135 live k1 parry presses; the first follow-up at +4..12 is inside the 12 f hitstun. Do not press: the press is swallowed and the 330 ms parry lock is spent.

User rule 2026-11-01: the first no-light follow-up after the gold opener is dodge-only, not parry. The old policy answered it with parry (135 k1 parry presses, 0 ok), which was the wrong response, not proof that the follow-up is unparryable. The k0 dodge cooldown (500 ms) is over (gap 20-49 f); 33 proven k0-dodged first-contact episodes, all cooldown-ok, 21/33 have no prior hitstun and can schedule a clean second dodge at f0-4; 12/33 are already in hitstun from a prior hit. The later k1/k2 are unknown (user 2026-11-01); do not assume they are parryable. No live clean 2-5 f second dodge yet; a 2v2 is required before runtime.

Only reachable if the gold k0 is parried. The old 120-round index has 20 k1 ok, all with k1 at +59..67 after a k0 ok/pf; the live phase-1 policy never parries a gold opener. Forbidden by the 金光闪 teacher rule; diagnostic only.

actions.name: execute
actions.condition: boss qi <= 25 and execute button lit

actions.name: light
actions.condition: weapon ready and boss in range

punish.note: Offline only: count contact-free windows after the last hitstun frame and schedule the best action. No damage verification; runtime offense stays off in this milestone.

forbidden.gold_parry: teacher rule: 金光闪. The 3 live k0:c11 'ok' contacts are none-colour follow-ups parried by a leftover c6 parry press at 17-20 f, not a repeatable gold-parry window.
